tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i sham+bha la'i rgyal rabs chos brgyud dang bcas pa skar rtsis skor 'ga' zhig bzhugs/

na mo shrī kā la tsakra ye/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /dngos brgyud bla ma la btud nas/ /de yi rgyal rabs chos brgyud dang*/ /rtsis kyi rim pa cung zad bri/ /'dir dus kyi 'khor lo nas bshad pa'i dgos don thor bu 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang 'di lugs la ri rab sogs kyi dbyibs zlum po yin la/ sa dkyil gyi zheng la dpag tshad 'bum dang mthar sum 'bum/ sa'i steng gi dkyil nas phyogs gcig gi lhun po'i rtsa ba'i mtha'i bar dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad/ de nas lhun po'i khor yug la stong phrag gcig de nas ri rnams kyi phyi ma bsil ri'i bar gyi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug gi sar nang gi gling mtsho ri drug gnas par bshad pa'i grangs bsdoms na/ dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga ste sa'i dbus nas lho phyogs kyi bsil ri tshun dang*/ de bzhin du sa'i dbus nas phyogs gzhan la yang 'dra'o/ /bsil ri'i mtha' nas lho phyogs kyi sa dky-il gyi mtha'i bar la yang dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga yod pas/ snga phyi bsdoms na sa'i dkyil nas phyogs gcig la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu ste/ lho byang gi phyogs gnyis bsdoms pas sa dkyil gyi zheng la dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig tu 'gyur la/ lhun po la rwa lnga yod pa'i rwa steng ma'i mas gsham dang bsil ri kha skoms pa'i khongs skyibs na nang gi ri gling mtsho rnams gnas so/ /bsil ri'i phyi nas phyogs bzhi re rer yang sa dkyil gyi zheng la dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga re yod pa la 'dzam gling chen po zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /sa'i steng du de dum bu bcu gnyis su bgos pa'i gling chen po bcu gnyis yod kyang phyogs bzhi'i gling gi dbus su shar du zla gam/ lhor gru gsum/ nub tu gru bzhi/ byang du zlum po'i rnam pa can gyi gling bzhi rim pa bzhin du shar dpag tshad bdud stong dang*/ lho brgyad stong dang byang dgu stong dang nub stong phrag bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi gling chung ngu re yod do/

/de ni bai dkar gyi lugs ltar yin la/ gzhung kha cig tu nub zlum po dang byang gru bzhi par bshad de dpyad bzhir snang ngo*/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di la lho nas byang du rim par 'phags yul dang*/ bod dang*/ li dang*/ rgya nag chung ngu dang*/ ke la sha dang*/ gangs ldan te yul drug gnas te/ nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe ni lho gling che ba'i dum bu'i phyed mtshams kyi steng thad nas rgyu zhing*/ de nas byang du mi 'ong bas 'phags yul ni rgyu mtshams de'i byang ngos na yod do/ /bai dkar las bsil ri'i phyi nas brtsis pa'i dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga'i phyed byang dngos su dpag tshad chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya'i sa'i cha dum bu drug tu byas pa'i cha der yul drug gnas par bshad pa ltar ram/ gzhung gzhan du rgyu mtshan der 'dzam+bu'i gling chung ngu gru gsum pa'i lho'i logs bstad cing*/ logs gnyis shar nub dang*/ gru gcig byang du bstad pa'i lho byang du dpag tshad brgyad stong yod pa la cha drug tu bgos pa'i yul re re'i zheng la dpag tshad stong dang sum brgya sum cu rtsa gsum dang sum cha re thob/ de yang 'phags yul dang bod dang li dang rgya nag chung ngu rnams bsdoms pas dpag tshad lnga stong sum brgya so gsum dang sum cha gcig /de nas byang du dpag tshad stong dang sum brgya so gsum dang sum cha ni kai la sha yin la/ sham+bha la ni kai la sha'i lho mtha' nas dpag tshad stong song ba'i byang gi cha la gnas par bshad cing*/ kai la sha nas dpag tshad stong dang sum brgya so gsum dang sum cha ni gangs ldan gyi sa'o/ /des na sham+bha la ni yul drug gi dum bu lnga pa kai la sha na yod par bshad pa ltar te/ sham+bha la'i yul gyi rgya zheng la ni dpag tshad lnga brgya'o/ /bai dkar ltar byas nas cha drug tu bgos na yul re re'i khyaun la dpag tshad nyis stong dang brgyad cu lhag tsam re 'byung ste sgo zhi la che chung yod pa'i dbang gis so/

/'di lugs kyi ri gling sogs kyi skor 'ga' zhig ni bdag gis gzhan du bshad zin kyang*/ 'dir sham+bha la'i chos rgyal dang rigs ldan rnams ji ltar byon pa'i tshul cung zad 'chad par 'dod nas sngon du de tsam zhig brjaud pa yin no/ /sham+bha la na yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug dang*/ de rnams su dbang byed pa'i rgyal po yang go drug yod par bshad cing*/ chos rgyal rigs ldan byon tshul ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas dus 'khor gsungs pa'i dus ni sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo la bzhed mkhan mang yang tshul 'dir 'khrul med phug lugs kyi bzhed pa ni/ ston pas lcags 'brug gi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i bcwo lnga'i skor la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs nas/ de'i sa ga'i bcwo lnga la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan par bshad pa ltar 'dod par bya ste/ de yang phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa chos rgyal zla bzang 'khor dang bcas pa sham+bha la nas rdzu 'phrul gyis 'phags yul du byon nas 'phags yul lho phyogs kyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs zhes par ston pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud zhug nas lar byon te lo gsum bzhugs nas gshegs so/ /'di'i sngon du rang gi yab mes la sogs pa rgyal po mang du byon yang dus 'khor brgyud pa'i dbang du mdzad nas zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs/ lha dbang ldan te chos rgyal bdun dang*/ de nas rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ bzang po/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug pas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang po/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong*/ dpal skyong*/ seṅge/ rnam gnon/ stobs chen/ ma 'gag pa/ mi'i seṅge/ dbang phyug /mtha' yas rnam rgyal/ drag po 'khor lo can te rigs ldan nyer lnga dang*/ chos rgyal bdun dang bcas na so gnyis te de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa'o/

/'di la bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpa' ba/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ mkhas grub rin po che/ stag tshang lots+tsha ba/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa/ tā ra nā tha/ byang ba rigs ldan grags pa sogs du ma zhig gis rgyud kyi tshig ris 'ga' zhig la brten nas/ chos rgyal dang rigs ldan de thams cad kyang rgyal srid la lo brgya re bzhugs pa sha stag tu bzhed la/ phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho yab sras dang*/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sogs kyis ni de lta na me mkha' rgya mtsho'i sgrub gzhi mi 'byung bas rgyud 'grel gy-i lung 'ga' zhig la brten nas/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gyis brgya gya gnyis dang*/ rgyal dkas nyis brgya nyer gcig khrir bzhugs te/ gnyis ka bsdom pas bzhi brgya dang gsum ni me mkha' brgya mtsho'i zhes bzhed pas rang lugs ni phyi ma ltar 'dod do/ /de ltar na drag po 'khor lo can theb par byas na lo sum stong bzhi brgya'i skor yin yang*/ lha dbang nas mtha' yas rnam rgyal gyi bar lo sum stong sum brgya dang*/ zla bzang gi lo gsum the bar byas na sum stong sum brgya dang gsum mo/ /rgyal po res lo brgya brgya sha stag tu bzhugs par bzhed pa ltar na ni/ lha dbang nas mtha' yas rnam rgyal rdzogs pa'i bar lo sum stong chig brgya tsam mo/ /'o na da lta rigs ldan gang khrir 'khod pa yin snyam na/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang rgyal dka' gnyis kyi lo bsdoms pas bzhi brgya dang gsum bzhugs par bzhed pa dang*/ chos rgyal rigs ldan re re lo brgya re mnyam par bzhugs par bzhed pa'i dbang gis da lta khrir gang 'khod mi 'dra ste/ gong du drangs pa'i bu ston/ bla ma dam pa/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal ba nas/ rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags pa sogs phal cher skabs der rigs ldan stobs chen rang du bzhed/ phug pa'i lugs la rab byung bcu gcig pa'i thog tu rigs ldan seṅge khrir 'khod nas me yos bcu gnyis pa'i thog yin la lo drug cu song gsung ste/

'on kyang da lo shing byi 'di'i bar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lo drug cu rdzogs pa la nye bas da lta ni/ rigs ldan rnam gnon khrir 'khod pa'i dus yin par gsal lo/ /jo nang tā ra nā thas ni da lta dpal skyong khri la bzhugs zhes bshad de/ khong mkhas grub rin po che gshegs pa'i rjes zha lu pa dang chos rje blo gros chos skyong gis khri mdzad pa'i tshe byung bar mngon/ rnam gnon nas rigs ldan drug song ba na drag po 'khor lo can 'byon par bshad do/ /'khor lo can gyi sngon du rigs ldan shin tu bzang po'i dus nas kyang ma kha'i yul du kla klo zhugs te/ 'khor lo can gyi dus su kla klo'i ston pa sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis kla klo'i chos lhag par dar bar byas pas chu bo shī ta'i lho phyogs thams cad kla klor gyur pa'i tshe 'khor lo can gyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas 'khor dang sprul pa'i dmag gis kla klo rnams bcom ste thams cad nang pa'i chos la bkod nas bstan pa nyams pa gso bar mdzad cing*/ kla klo'i gnas tshad ni lo stong dang brgyad brgya'o/ /chos rgyal dang rigs ldan gyi khyad par ni/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rigs ldan grags pas yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug na yod pa'i tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rnams 'dul bar dgongs shing*/ ma btul na de dag gi bu brgyud las kla klo'i chos 'byung bar mkhyen pa dang*/ de dag btul na gzhan mang po zhig sngags lam la 'jug par yang mkhyen te/ de rnams ni 'jam po kho nas mi thul bar gzigs nas drang srong rnams bkug nas smras pa/ khyed rnams kyis rang rang gi lta ba tha dad pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi lugs kyi spyod pa tha dad pa rnams dor te rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par gyis shig /gal te 'jug par mi 'dod na ni yul gzhan du song zhig ces gsungs pas/ de rnams rdo rje'i theg par 'jug ma 'dod nas 'phags yul du song ba'i zhag bcu pa la nags tshal chen por zhugs pa'i tshe/

rgyal pos de rnams gnyid 'thug pos mnon par byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha mthu bo che dag la bka' bsgos te gnyid ma sad pa kho nar nam mkha'i ngos su skad cig gis khyer nas 'ongs te/ sham+bha la'i yul du rgyal po zla ba bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su slebs pa na gnyid sad par gyur to/ /de nas thams cad ya mtshan du gyur cing*/ blon po rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyis brda sbyar te nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil khor du bcug nas dbang bskur ste/ rigs sna tshogs pa rnams rdo rje'i theg pa la rigs gcig tu mdzad pas 'jam dpal grags pa nyid rigs ldan gyi thog mar gyur cing*/ drang srong rnams kyis kyang rigs ldan gyi lam grub bo/ /rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa ltar rtsa rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'i bsdus rgyud 'phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor can sho lo ka stong dang sum cu yod pa mdzad de/ de nyid 'phags yul dang bod du 'gyur zhing rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu drug pa yongs rdzogs sham+bha la nas rgya bod du ma 'gyur yang*/ mtshan brjod ni 'di'i nang nas phyung bar bshad cing*/ dbang mdor bstan yang de las phyung bar mngon te 'gyur ro/ /grags pa'i sras spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos rtsa rgyud dang yab kyis mdzad pa'i bsdus rgyud kyi 'grel pa zung 'grel dri med 'od zer bya ba stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad de 'dir 'gyur ro/ /me mkha' rgya mtsho nas lo brgya dang gya gnyis 'das pa mi zad pa me khyir rtsis 'go zug /de yang lo brgya dang re gcig 'das pa'i me yos de rtsis 'go zug nas me yos gsum pa'i thog yin la/ phug lugs la rab byung 'di khongs su dus kyi 'khor lo sham+bha la nas 'phags yul du phebs pa yin zhes bshad cing*/

spyan 'dren mkhan dang phebs pa'i dus la ni rwa 'bro gnyis kyi lugs cung zad re mi 'dra ba snang ste/ 'bro lugs la ni rigs ldan du zhabs pa che ba/ chung ba/ bho dhi bha dra/ zla mgon/ lha rje sgom sogs dang*/ rwa lugs ni/ tsi lu pa/ piṇ+ḍo ā tsar+ya/ dus zhabs pa sogs 'dren te dus zhabs pa che ba dang*/ tsi lu pa gnyis gang gis thog mar dus 'khor sham+bha la nas 'phags yul du spyan drangs pa mi mthun no/ /de nas/ lo tsā ba gyi jo/ khram lo tsā ba/ 'bro shes rab grags sogs lo tsā ba mang pos dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang 'grel pa bod skad du bsgyur nas dar bar mdzad do/ / 'bro lugs la ni rab byung thog ma der paṇ+ḍi ta la mgon gyis dus 'khor bod du spyan drangs zhes bzhed cing*/ phug lugs la dus kyi 'khor lo 'phags yul du phebs pa'i dus ni gong du bshad pa ltar yin kyang*/ g.ya' sel las/ byings mangs thams cad rab byung thog mar 'phags yul du phebs par bzhed bzhin du zhes bshad pas phebs lo la mi 'dra ba yod do/ /des na kha cig rab byung thog ma ni dus 'khor 'phags yul du phebs pa nas rtsis zer yang don la me stag gi mjug tu gza' skar rnam stong par zhugs te/ me yos kyi thogs mar slar gza' skar gyi 'go brtsams pa'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ lo de'i gsum pa'i tshes gcig la ni gza' nyi ma dang skar ma tha skar 'char ro/ /dus 'khor nas rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad cing*/ lha'i mngon rtogs sgom tshul dang rdzogs rim gyi skor sbyor drug gi nyams len rnams sngon dar ba byung dug kyang da lta ni de tsam mi gsal la/ 'jig rten khams le sogs nas bshad pa'i rtsis kyi tshul ni phyogs kun tu dar ro/ /de la yang sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gi bzhed pa la 'dra mi 'dra sna tshogs byung yang mchog tu gyur pa ni phug pa yab sras nas brgyud pa'i lugs bai dkar sogs nas bshad pa ltar te/

'di la yang byed rtsis dang grub rtsis gnyis so/ /tshul 'dir kho bos phyogs tsam zhig sbyangs pa'i lag rjes thor bu 'ga' zhig ni gzhan du bris zin la/ gzhung 'di'i don phra mo'i gnad kun la nges pa gting ma phyin pas dgod par mi 'os kyang rang 'dod dang gzhan 'ga' re la phan khyad mkhas pa'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi tshul 'ga' zhig brjod par bya'o/ /'di la lnga/ thog mar rtsis la mkho ba'i mngon brjod/ dgu mtha'/ grub rtsis lnga bsdus kyi skor/ sgra gcan dang byed rtsis lnga bsdus dang gza' 'dzin gyi skor/ dus sbyor gyi skor/ mgyogs rtsis mtshon tsam mo/ dang po la mngon brjod dang dgu mtha' gnyis kyi snga ma ni//༈ zla ba gzugs dang 'od dkar can/ /bse ru ri bong can sogs gcig /'khrig bgrod mtshe ma thabs shes dang*/ lag mi gzung rnams gnyis kyi ming*/ /'jig rten tsha ba rtse mo me/ /yon tan srid pa gsum gyi ming*/ /rgya mtsho chu bo rig byed dang*/ bdud dang sde ba chu gter bzhi/ /'dod yon nyer spyod dbang po dang*/ mda' dang 'byung ba lnga yi ming*/ /ro dus mtshams dang bro ba dang*/ / rgyan dang bzang po drug tu grags/ /rin chen sa 'dzin thub pa dang*/ /ri bo drang srong gza' rta bdun/ /bkra shis lha klu nor lha dang*/ /gdengs can srid pa lto 'gro brgyad/ /rtsa sgo srin po bu ga dang*/ /gter rnams dgu yi ming yin la/ /khro bo 'byor ba phyogs 'jug pa/ /stobs dang sor mo bcu ru 'dod/ /bde byed bde 'byung dbang phyug dang*/ /drag po byed pa bcu gcig ming*/ /nyi ma rten 'brel khyim bcu gnyis/ /'dod pa lus med gdugs bcu gsum/ /srid yid ma nu bcu bzhi'i ming*/ /tshes dang nyin zhag bcwo lngar grags/ /mi bdag rgyal po bcu drug la/ /skyon dang nyes pa khams bcwo brgyad/ /rgyal ba yul ni nyer bzhi'i ming*/ / 'khor lo skar ma nyer bdun la/ /so dang gnyis skyes so gnyis ming*/

/stong pa nam mkha' thig le ste/ /grangs la mkho ba de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa la/ de nas dgu mtha' nges pa ni/ /dgu gcig gcig dgu dgu rang la/ /dgu gnyis gnyis dgu bcwo brgyad yin/ /dgu gsum gsum dgu nyi shu bdun/ /dgu bzhi bzhi dgu sum cu drug /dgu lnga lnga dgu bzhi bcu lnga/ / dgu drug drug dgu lnga bcu bzhi/ /dgu bdun bdun dgu drug cu gsum/ /dgu brgyad brgyad dgu bdun cu gnyis/ /dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig go /brgyad gcig gcig brgyad brgyad rang yin/ /brgyad gnyis gnyis brgyad bcu drug la/ /brgyad gsum gsum brgya nyi shu bzhi/ /brgyad bzhi bzhi brgyad sum cu gnyis/ /brgyad lnga lnga brgyad bzhi bcu tham/ /brgyad drug drug brgyad bzhi bcu brgyad/ /brgyad bdun bdun brgyad lnga bcu drug /brgyad brgyad drug cu re bzhi'o/ /brgyad dgu dgu brgyad bdun cu gnyis/ /bdun gcig gcig bdun bdun rang yin/ /bdun gnyis gnyis bdun bcu bzhi la/ /bdun gsum gsum bdun nyi shu gcig/bdun bzhi bzhi bdun nyi shu brgyad/ /bdun lnga lnga bdun sum cu lnga/ /bdun drug drug bdun bzhi bcu gnyis/ /bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu la/ /bdun brgyad brgyad bdun lnga bcu drug /bdun dgu dgu bdun drug cu gsum/ /drug gcig gcig drug drug rang yin/ /drug gnyis gnyis drug bcu gnyis la/ /drug gsum gsum drug bcwo brgyad de/ /drug bzhi bzhi drug nyi shu bzhi/ /drug lnga lnga drug sum cu tham/ /drug drug sum cu so drug ste/ /drug bdun bdun drug bzhi bcu gnyis/ /drug brgyad brgyad drug bzhi bcu brgyad/ /drug dgu dgu drug lnga bcu bzhi/ /lnga gcig gcig lnga lnga rang la/ /lnga gnyis gnyis lnga bcu tham pa/ /lnga gsum gsum lnga bcwo lnga la/ /lnga bzhi bzhi lnga nyi shu tham/ /lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /lnga drug drug lnga sum cu tham/ /lnga bdun bdun lnga sum cu lnga/

/lnga brgyad brgyad lnga bzhi bcu tham/ /lnga dgu dgu lnga bzhi bcu lnga/ /bzhi gcig gcig bzhi bzhi rang yin/ /bzhi gnyis gnyis bzhi brgyad du 'dod/ /bzhi gsum gsum bzhi bcu gnyis te/ /bzhi bzhi dag la bcu drug go / bzhi lnga lnga bzhi nyi shu tham/ /bzhi drug drug bzhi nyi shu bzhi/ /bzhi bdun bdun bzhi nyi shu brgyad/ /bzhi brgyad brgyad bzhi sum cu gnyis/ /bzhi dgu dgu bzhi sum cu drug /gsum gcig gcig gsum gsum rang yin/ /gsum gnyis gnyis gsum drug yin la/ /gsum gsum dgu ru 'dod pa yin/ /gsum bzhi bzhi gsum bcu gnyis la/ /gsum lnga lnga gsum bco lnga ste/ /gsum drug drug gsum bcwo brgyad do/ /gsum bdun bdun gsum nyi shu gcig /gsum brgyad brgyad gsum nyi shu bzhi/ /gsum dgu dgu gsum nyi shu bdun/ /gnyis gcig gcig gnyis gnyis rang yin/ /gnyis gnyis bzhi ste gnyis gsum drug / gnyis bzhi bzhi gnyis brgyad yin la/ /gnyis lnga lnga gnyis bcu tham pa/ / gnyis drug drug gnyis bcu gnyis te/ /gnyis bdun bdun gnyis bcu bzhi la/ /gnyis brgyad brgyad gnyis bcu drug ste/ /gnyis dgu dgu gnyis bcwo brgyad do/ /gcig gcig gcig gnyis la sogs te/ gcig gis bsgyur la mang nyung med/ /'dri dang bgrang ba g.yas nas te/ /bsgyur dang bgod pa g.yon nas bya/ /sgyur byed mtha' yi thig le rnams/ /bsgyur bya de yi gral mthar dgod/ / bsgyur bya stong na bsgyur rgyu med/ /sgyur byed stong na bsgyur gzhi dbyi/ /bgo byed mtha' dbus thig le ni/ /rang gnas 'dzin las bgod nus med/ /thig le gral mgor 'byung mi srid/ /ma thob nor skal thig le byin/ /rkyang bgod ci tsam thob pa khyer/ /sprags 'god 'og ma'i tshod dang sbyor/ /gza' dang byed pa'i 'khor lo bdun/ /skar sbyor gnyis ni nyer bdun no/ /thob nor gang yin gong mar bsre/ /gnas gong thob nor phal cher dor/
